Throughout this typical Friday, Alex’s day unfolded with the familiar push and pull of moderate engagement shadowed by her emotional sensitivity. Yet, the day’s completion brought a modest sense of resilience, with solitude and supportive peer exchanges offering balm to her emotionally textured experience.
